messages.content: You are a bounded Janus feature-design assistant. Use only the redacted input package. Return exactly one JSON object and no prose. Do not claim implementation, task creation, Git authority, release authority, or final product decision authority. Your job is only to consolidate already-given answers into a bounded structured decision summary draft or exactly one blocking question.

Return a JSON object with these exact top-level fields: status, decision_state, recommended_next_skill, notes, structured_decision_summary, blocking_question, option_a, option_b, recommendation.

Rules:
- status must be PASS, WEAK_SIGNAL, or BLOCKED
- decision_state must be DECISION_SUMMARY_READY or BLOCKING_QUESTION
- recommended_next_skill must be janus-spec-generator, janus-backlog-intake, or NEEDS_INFO
- notes must contain 1 to 4 short strings
- if decision_state is DECISION_SUMMARY_READY, structured_decision_summary must be an object with exactly these keys: Feature Name, Primary Goal, User Problem, User Value, Primary Target Surface, Existing or New Surface, Existence Confirmation, User Trigger, Success Behavior, Failure Behavior, User Action Surface, Data / Persistence, Security / Privacy, Edge Cases, Out of Scope, Routing Decision, Routing Reason, Recommended Next Skill
- if decision_state is BLOCKING_QUESTION, provide exactly one blocking_question plus option_a, option_b, and recommendation, and do not invent a finished decision summary
- Routing Decision must match the best bounded interpretation of the locked answers and should usually equal the expected routing decision when the package is sufficiently locked
- Do not claim final product authority; Codex remains the final decision owner

Redacted input package JSON:
{
  "workflow_id": "WF-FEATURE-DESIGN-PACKAGE-001",
  "bound_skill_context": "janus-feature-design",
  "raw_feature_request": "Ich moechte in bestehenden Janus-Skills immer waehlen koennen, ob Codex die Aufgabe lokal macht oder ob ein begrenzter OpenRouter-Arbeitspfad genutzt wird, damit ich flexibel Codex-Kontingent sparen kann.",
  "locked_answers": [
    "Feature Name: Operator-facing Codex-oder-OR-Wahl in bestehenden Janus-Skills",
    "Primary Goal: In passenden bestehenden Janus-Skills soll am Einstieg sichtbar zwischen lokalem Codex-Pfad und bounded OR-Pfad gewaehlt werden koennen.",
    "User Problem: Der Nutzer will je nach Codex-Kontingent und erwarteten OR-Kosten flexibel entscheiden koennen, welcher Pfad fuer eine konkrete Aufgabe sinnvoller ist.",
    "Primary Target Surface: bestehende Janus-Skill-Einstiege",
    "Existing or New Surface: bestehend",
    "Existence Confirmation: confirmed by user",
    "User Trigger: Start eines geeigneten Janus-Skills mit bounded OR-Kandidaten",
    "Success Behavior: Der Skill zeigt sichtbar 1 = Codex und 2 = OR inklusive Kosten-/Evidenzhinweis und faellt fail-closed lokal zurueck, wenn kein freigegebener bounded OR-Lane passt.",
    "Failure Behavior: Nicht freigegebene, partielle oder ungesunde OR-Lanes duerfen nicht als normale Wahl erscheinen; in solchen Faellen bleibt nur der lokale Codex-Pfad sichtbar.",
    "User Action Surface: bewusste Auswahl zwischen Codex und OR am Skill-Einstieg",
    "Data / Persistence: nur Telemetrie, Gate-Evidenz und vorhandene Skill-/Routing-Artefakte; keine neue Produktpersistenz",
    "Security / Privacy: keine broad delegated authority, keine Production-Routing-Aktivierung, Codex behaelt finale Validierung und Autoritaet",
    "Edge Cases: fehlende Gate-Daten, fehlende OR-Freigabe, partielle Kandidaten, unvollstaendige Telemetrie, Healthcheck-Fehler",
    "Out of Scope: globale OR-Freigabe, canonical routing-table update, broad delegated repo authority, release actions"
  ],
  "expected_routing_decision": "FULL FEATURE PIPELINE",
  "expected_next_skill": "janus-spec-generator",
  "expected_output": "One bounded latest decision summary draft or one blocking question, with no implementation, task creation, or final product authority claims.",
  "redaction_ready": true
}
